title: Personal Credit Cards: confirming the closure of a card
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: closure by the cardholder's confirmation

This entry covers the Personal Credit Cards line of Piedmont Crescent Bank and is the invocation reference for confirm_card_closure_806ea607.

## What the policy governs

- **Situation:** a cardholder closes one of their cards.
- **Handling:** closing a card is the cardholder's own confirmation, recorded together with the automatic payment option that stays on the closed card.
- **No separate request:** no separate closure request is registered by the agent. The cardholder's own confirmation on the card account is the closure record, and the account closes at that confirmation and not before.
- **Result it decides:** the automatic payment option left on the closed card.

## Entry condition

All of the card's unredeemed points have been cashed out before the closure is confirmed. The reason is that points are forfeited at closure. Where the condition is unmet, the closure is not confirmed.

## How the tool is invoked

confirm_card_closure_806ea607 is a customer-side tool. It must first be unlocked and handed over, to be run by the customer themselves: the agent unlocks it with unlock_user_discoverable_tool, and the customer themselves then runs it as their confirmation.

## What one call does

One call confirms, as the cardholder, the closure of one of their own credit card accounts and states which automatic payment instruction stays on it. It sets the card account's status to closed with today's date as the closing date and sets its autopay option to the value given. Any balance still owed stays payable, and the card can no longer be used. The cardholder sees the card as closed at once. The tool checks nothing before posting.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| card_account_id | the reference number of the credit card account being closed, as returned by the card account lookup | reference number text |
| autopay_option | the automatic payment option that remains on the closed card | exactly one of the values below |

Allowed values of autopay_option:

- none: no automatic payment continues after closure.
- minimum_due: the minimum payment keeps being debited until the balance is paid.
- statement_balance: the full statement balance keeps being debited until the balance is paid.
- fixed_amount: the fixed amount already on the card keeps being debited until the balance is paid.

## Return

A text rendering of a dictionary with: status (always "closed" when the closure was recorded), card_account_id, closed_date (YYYY-MM-DD, today) and autopay_option (the option left on the closed card). The call is complete when the receipt comes back with status "closed"; no other outcome is defined for this tool.
